summary: Playwright end-to-end tests and CI are removed; UI checks use Laravel Herd and Cursor's built-in browser, with docs updated to match.
detailed_changes: Removed Playwright packages, config, tests/e2e and the CI e2e job; PHPUnit and frontend CI jobs remain (#828, #830, #831).
AGENTS.md and design docs describe Herd + Cursor browser for UI verification instead of Playwright (#829).
VisualRegressionSeeder remains for manual demo datasets; comments no longer refer to Playwright (#829).
affected_areas: Page or route: none (CI and local verification only)
User groups affected: developers and agents verifying UI locally
Internal impact: no Playwright install or e2e job in CI; preview UI on http://apes-newsroom.test
